description:
Use this when the user wants to add a person to their RipClip team: "invite my editor", "add
        sam@example.com to my team", "give my manager access". It emails the invite to another person, so confirm the
        address with the user first. email: the person's address. Only an account with team seats can invite (the
        plan the billing page shows); a limit of 20 invites an hour applies, and an invite lasts 7 days. They accept
        after signing in to RipClip.
        Not for: removing a member or changing what they may do (done in RipClip), or the account's own invite link
        (get_invite_link). Free: no Horizon Units. Next: get_team shows the invite waiting.
name: invite_team_member
title: Invite someone to my team
